claim_scope: fixed-seed sampled sensitivity audit in the frozen braking domain; not exhaustive verification and not a second domain

detection_semantics.independent_oracle_detected: at least one exact trace or downstream signature differs from the independent frozen oracle
detection_semantics.oracle_comparison_detected: at least one exact trace or downstream signature differs from the independent frozen oracle
detection_semantics.signature_detected: at least one six-bit pairwise behavioral signature differs; this is a lower-resolution downstream check
detection_semantics.trace_detected: at least one complete observation/action/status trace differs exactly from the oracle
